root_cause.note: GPU driver DaemonSet: hostNetwork + privileged containers + broad hostPath mounts.

evidence.analysis: The NVIDIA driver DaemonSet combines hostNetwork: true, privileged containers and hostPath mounts of /, /dev, /sys, kernel modules and container runtime sockets - the canonical privileged-node posture. Any container escape or compromised image in this DaemonSet is instant node takeover; recorded as posture (static), paired with the validator exec surface case.
